identitySignals: Keenan & Associates (named in the agenda as administrator) describes Northern California ReLiEF (NCR) as a non-profit, member-owned California joint powers authority serving local educational agencies, matching OUSD's 'Legal, insurance & risk' excess property and liability coverage purchase
A 2010-era press release datelined Torrance, CA, which matches the agenda's Torrance location, names Keenan as ReLiEF's JPA manager and lists www.norcalrelief.org as the NCR website

The agenda text also names a second entity, PRISM (Public Risk Innovation, Solutions, and Management), a separate joint powers authority based in Folsom, CA; this record cannot be described as one organization
research.notes: The vendor line covers two entities: Northern California ReLiEF (administered by Keenan, Torrance CA) and PRISM (Folsom, CA). This profile covers NCR only. NCR's own site (norcalrelief.org) is a JavaScript app with no readable text, and registry pages (State Controller) block automated fetch, so legal name, phone, address and registry IDs could not be verified from a citable page; they were left null. Reported address 2355 Crenshaw Blvd, Suite 200, Torrance, CA 90501 is Keenan's office; unverified for NCR.

profile.summary: Northern California ReLiEF is one of two regional risk-sharing programs that make up ReLiEF (Regional Liability Excess Fund). It is a non-profit, member-owned California joint powers authority that provides property and liability coverage to local educational agencies such as school districts.

sources.title: ReLiEF Joint Powers Authority for Public Educational Agencies Releases More Than $6 Million to Members
